# Deployments

Find Uniswap v2 factory and router deployment addresses across supported networks.

All Uniswap v2 deployment addresses are also available on the unified [Deployments](https://developers.uniswap.org/deployments) page and its [deployments.json](https://developers.uniswap.org/deployments.json) feed.

Contract addresses for the [`Uniswap v2 Factory`](https://github.com/Uniswap/v2-core/blob/master/contracts/UniswapV2Factory.sol) and the [`Uniswap v2 Router02`](https://github.com/Uniswap/v2-periphery/blob/master/contracts/UniswapV2Router02.sol).
